means.都: 都 means 'all' or 'both'. It points back to a group that comes before it: 我们都…, 这些菜我都….
means.也: 也 means 'also' or 'too'. One more person or thing does the same as before.

items.why: 都 sums up the group 我们: all of us.

items.en: He is a student, and I am a student too.
items.why: 也: one more person, me, is the same.

items.en: He likes tea, and so do I.
items.why: 也: I like it too.

items.en: I like all of these dishes.
items.why: 都 points back to 这些菜: all of them.
都 covers everyone in 你们.
都 covers the two people: both.

items.en: You don't know? I don't know either.
items.why: 也 + 不 is 'not either'. 我都不知道 would mean 'I had no idea at all'.

items.en: Mum and Dad are both at home.
items.why: 都 covers the two people before it.

items.zh: 他会写汉字，[也]会说汉语。
items.en: He can write characters, and he can also speak Chinese.
items.why: 也: one more thing he can do.

means.不: 不 says no to the present, the future, a habit, a wish or a quality. It goes before 是, 会, 想 and describing words.
means.没: 没 says something did not happen, or has not happened yet. It is always 没 before 有.

items.en: I didn't go to school yesterday.
items.why: Yesterday: it did not happen, so 没.

items.en: I'm not going to school tomorrow.
items.why: Tomorrow, and it is your choice: 不.
A liking, true in general: 不.
有 always takes 没: 没有.
A describing word (冷) takes 不.
是 always takes 不: 不是.
还没 = not yet: it has not happened so far.
会 takes 不: 不会.
想 takes 不: a wish, not an event.

items.en: I didn't see him last week.
items.why: Last week, it did not happen: 没.

means.吗: 吗 turns a statement into a plain yes/no question. Never with a question word like 什么 or 哪儿.
means.呢: 呢 asks 'and you?' or 'where is…?', and it can sit at the end of a question that already has a question word.
means.吧: 吧 makes a suggestion (let's…) or checks a guess (…, right?).

items.why: A plain yes/no question: 吗.
'And you?' is 你呢.
A suggestion: 吧.
Checking a guess: 吧. 你是老师吗 would be a plain question with no guess.
The question already has 什么, so 吗 cannot go here; 呢 can.
Noun + 呢 asks where it is.
A plain yes/no question: 吗.

items.en: It's too late. Let's talk about it tomorrow.
items.why: A suggestion: 吧.
哪儿 is already the question word, so 吗 cannot go here; 呢 makes it softer.
